_doc: USER-PATH-1: the guided set-up, one yes/no question per screen, every action a single click. Source of truth for ultrastable.io/setup (site/userpath.js is generated from this file by scripts/gen_userpath.py). Text shown to people may not use technical words (checked by the generator). {user} is the GitHub name the person types once; {project} is the name of their copy.

steps.ask: Do you have a GitHub account?
steps.why: GitHub is where your project lives. It is free.

no.label: Create a free account
no.then: Come back here when you are signed in.

steps.why: We use it to take you to the right pages. It is saved only in this browser.

steps.ask: Make your own copy of the project?
steps.why: One click. Nothing to type except a name for your copy.

yes.label: Make my copy
yes.then: Pick any name, choose Private, press the green button.

steps.ask: What name did you give your copy?
steps.why: So we can take you straight to it. Saved only in this browser.

steps.ask: Do you have a Cloudflare account?
steps.why: Cloudflare runs your project on the internet. The free plan is enough to start.

no.label: Create a free account
no.then: Come back here when you see your Cloudflare home page.

steps.why: Cloudflare asks to see your copy; you press Allow. After that it keeps your project online by itself.

yes.label: Connect
yes.then: Choose [Import a repository], pick your copy, press Save and Deploy.

steps.confirm: Does Cloudflare say it is deployed?

steps.why: This lets your project check itself, fix itself and improve itself every day.

yes.label: Open my project
yes.then: If you see a green button that says I understand my workflows, press it.

steps.confirm: Did you press it, or was there nothing to press?

steps.ask: Want to connect Google (calendar, email, storage)?
steps.why: Optional. You can do this any time.

yes.label: Open Google
yes.then: Sign in; we will ask you to allow access when it is needed.

steps.ask: Want to post to social media automatically?
steps.why: Optional. Buffer schedules posts for you.

yes.label: Create a Buffer account
yes.then: Come back here when you see your Buffer home page.

done.title: You are set up.
done.text: Your project now runs by itself. Come back to this page any time to see what is switched on, or to add something new.
